mechanism.summary: Extend the existing shape-independent typed-loop executor so a numeric-consuming named read can stay in a scalar register and a named write of a scalar Number can avoid boxing, while a dense local array element can be retained as a boxed ordinary receiver only when a later property operation requires it.
mechanism.generality: Selection derives solely from existing typed-loop bytecode dataflow: an unshared GetPropNamed result must be consumed as a scalar, an array length is read only from a real Array, a named read must observe an ordinary own Number data property, and a named write must reach a writable own Number data property from a live Number. It applies to every admitted loop with that dataflow and never inspects workload names, source paths, function identities, inputs, iteration counts, or outputs. Inherited properties, accessors, Proxies, primitives, non-Number values, read-only or missing write targets, array holes, non-dense arrays, dynamic scope, direct eval, and unsupported dataflow retain the ordinary interpreter at the original bytecode instruction.
semantic_risks: a scalar property read must deopt before observable lookup when the receiver is not an Array length or an ordinary own Number data property, preserving inherited, accessor, Proxy, and primitive behavior
a scalar property write must retain property descriptor checks, assignment completion value, NaN, signed zero, Infinity, and exact bytecode-order visibility before any fallback
rewriting a local dense-array element from scalar to boxed receiver form must preserve element-read order, holes, proxy exclusion, and the original operand stack at every deoptimization point
shared property-slot caches must continue to validate the live receiver layout and current value so deletion, redefinition, or a non-Number replacement cannot expose stale data
the existing typed-loop compiler must keep generic boxed reads and writes whenever one property result has multiple consumers or cannot be proven to remain in the scalar domain

The existing typed-loop scalar/control program already represents its remaining work, but declines because those object operations exceed the boxed-operation ratio.
